paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the impact of the recent sequence ratio on inference performance and GPU memory usage for two methods—Perplexity and Full Cache PPL—evaluated on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B models using an A100 80GB GPU. The x-axis represents the recent sequence ratio in percentage, ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity," ranges from 4.2 to 4.7, while the right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," spans from 40 to 100. The orange line with circular markers, labeled "Perplexity," shows a decreasing trend from approximately 4.6 at 0% to 4.3 at 40%, then fluctuates slightly between 4.3 and 4.4 before rising to about 4.4 at 100%. The blue line with circular markers, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio," increases steadily from around 42% at 0% to 95% at 100%. The dashed red line, labeled "Full Cache PPL," remains constant at a perplexity of 4.4 across all values of the recent sequence ratio. The dashed blue line, labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem.," stays constant at a GPU memory ratio of 60% across all values. This suggests that as the recent sequence ratio increases, the perplexity and GPU memory usage for the Perplexity method increase, while the Full Cache PPL and Full Cache GPU Mem. remain unchanged.
